<!-- Copy to .dev-workflow/task.md. Replace placeholders and update after meaningful progress. -->

- Task: `<objective and scope; issue or PR link if available>`
- Branch: `<branch>`
- Intended PR base: `<ref> (<resolved revision>)`
- Working revision and state: `<HEAD>; <clean or dirty>`
- Validation: `not run`, or `<runnable command and relevant environment>; <tested revision or not recorded>; <clean, dirty, or not recorded at admission>; <observed result or unfinished>`
- Failing selector: `<exact selector(s), or none>`
- Evidence: `<completion record, manually captured log or terminal reference, review links, or none; original terminal/task handle for unfinished validation>`
- Next action: `<one concrete action>`
- Stop after: `<user-requested outcome, including any review handoff or follow-up>`
